notes.title: Fixed bugs, added confirmation screen when starting the game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012085/71e84d4408ba75c283e7b2aa8a0b1c6adc510278.png[/img]

-Fixed an auto-save bug that occurred in Chapter 2 and Episode 2.

-Added a confirmation screen that appears when starting the game
If you want to play from where you left off, click "Resume".
If you encounter problems such as the screen freezing when you continue from the beginning, please select "No" and play from the beginning of the story (only auto-save data will be deleted).

What is auto save data:
For example, if you end the game while reading Chapter 1, Chapter 1, the text is recorded so that you can restart from the text at the end.
Please rest assured that even if you reset this data, the data for Chapter 0 that you have already read will not be deleted.
